text:
Q: Are Boldr watch straps BPA-free?
A: Yes. All Boldr FKM rubber and silicone straps are 100% BPA-free. This applies to all current strap SKUs in the catalogue. The leather and nylon NATO straps do not contain BPA by composition.

metadata.question: Are Boldr watch straps BPA-free?

id: faq::general::What grade of titanium is used in the Expedition case?
text:
Q: What grade of titanium is used in the Expedition case?
A: The Expedition uses Grade 5 Titanium (Ti-6Al-4V), which is the aerospace-grade alloy - approximately 45% lighter than stainless steel and significantly more corrosion-resistant. The Journey uses Grade 2 (commercially pure titanium), which is slightly softer but still very durable.

metadata.question: What grade of titanium is used in the Expedition case?

id: faq::general::Is the watch safe for children?
text:
Q: Is the watch safe for children?
A: The Expedition and Journey models are designed for adults. That said, all materials are EU REACH and RoHS compliant, meaning they meet European safety standards for hazardous substances. The rubber straps are BPA-free and non-toxic. We recommend adult supervision for children wearing any watch.

metadata.question: Is the watch safe for children?

text:
Q: Do the straps contain nickel?
A: The FKM rubber and nylon NATO straps are nickel-free. The metal buckle on leather straps is made from Grade 5 titanium, which is also nickel-free. The mesh bracelet uses 316L stainless steel - trace nickel content is present (as with all stainless steel). If you have a severe nickel allergy, we recommend the rubber or NATO strap options.

metadata.question: Do the straps contain nickel?

id: faq::general::Is the luminous material on the dial safe?
text:
Q: Is the luminous material on the dial safe?
A: Yes. Boldr uses Super-LumiNova (BGW9 or C3 grade depending on model), which is a non-radioactive photoluminescent pigment compliant with ISO 3157. It is completely safe for everyday wear.

metadata.question: Is the luminous material on the dial safe?

id: faq::general::Does the watch meet EU safety standards?
text:
Q: Does the watch meet EU safety standards?
A: Yes. All Boldr watches are EU REACH compliant and RoHS compliant. Documentation is available upon request.

metadata.question: Does the watch meet EU safety standards?

id: faq::general::Can I get the caseback engraved?
text:
Q: Can I get the caseback engraved?
A: Yes. We offer caseback engraving in Roman/Latin script, Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters, and Arabic script. Pricing starts at SGD 25 for up to 20 characters. See our engraving rate card for full pricing.

metadata.question: Can I get the caseback engraved?

id: faq::general::How many characters can I engrave?
text:
Q: How many characters can I engrave?
A: Up to 60 characters maximum on the caseback. For Latin script: up to 20 characters at SGD 25, 21-40 at SGD 40, then SGD 1.50 per additional character. For CJK or Arabic: SGD 3.00 per character, up to 15 characters.

metadata.question: How many characters can I engrave?

id: faq::general::Can I engrave a logo or image?
text:
Q: Can I engrave a logo or image?
A: Yes, for an additional SGD 60. You must supply a vector file (.ai or .svg). Our team will review the design for feasibility before confirming.

metadata.question: Can I engrave a logo or image?

text:
Q: How long does engraving take?
A: Standard engraving adds 2-3 business days to processing time. Rush same-day engraving (SGD 20 surcharge) is available for orders placed before 12pm SGT, subject to availability.

metadata.question: How long does engraving take?

id: faq::general::Can I change the engraving text after ordering?
text:
Q: Can I change the engraving text after ordering?
A: If you contact us within 1 hour of placing the order, we can amend the text at no charge. After 1 hour, a SGD 15 correction fee applies. Once engraving has begun, changes are not possible.

metadata.question: Can I change the engraving text after ordering?

id: faq::general::Can the strap buckle be engraved?
text:
Q: Can the strap buckle be engraved?
A: Yes, for metal buckles only (not rubber or NATO straps). Up to 10 characters for SGD 15.

metadata.question: Can the strap buckle be engraved?

id: faq::general::What lug width do Boldr watches use?
text:
Q: What lug width do Boldr watches use?
A: All current Boldr models (Expedition and Journey) use a 20mm lug width. This is a standard size compatible with most third-party straps.

metadata.question: What lug width do Boldr watches use?

text:
Q: Are the straps quick-release?
A: Yes. All Boldr straps use a quick-release spring bar mechanism - no tools required to swap straps.

metadata.question: Are the straps quick-release?

id: faq::general::Can I use a NATO strap on the Expedition?
text:
Q: Can I use a NATO strap on the Expedition?
A: Yes. Any standard 20mm NATO strap is compatible with the Expedition and Journey.

metadata.question: Can I use a NATO strap on the Expedition?

id: faq::general::Can I swap straps between the Expedition and Journey?
text:
Q: Can I swap straps between the Expedition and Journey?
A: Yes. Both models share the same 20mm lug width, so all Boldr straps are interchangeable between the two.

metadata.question: Can I swap straps between the Expedition and Journey?

id: faq::general::What strap do you recommend for swimming?
text:
Q: What strap do you recommend for swimming?
A: The FKM rubber strap is the best choice for water activities - it is waterproof, quick-drying, and salt-resistant. The nylon NATO strap is also water-resistant but takes longer to dry. We do not recommend the leather strap for regular water exposure.

metadata.question: What strap do you recommend for swimming?

id: faq::general::How do I care for the leather strap?
text:
Q: How do I care for the leather strap?
A: Keep the leather strap away from prolonged water exposure. Apply a small amount of leather conditioner every 3-6 months. Avoid direct sunlight for extended periods to prevent fading.

metadata.question: How do I care for the leather strap?

id: faq::general::How much does a battery replacement cost?
text:
Q: How much does a battery replacement cost?
A: SGD 35, with a 3-5 business day turnaround. This includes a basic water resistance test and function check.

metadata.question: How much does a battery replacement cost?

id: faq::general::What is included in a Full Service?
text:
Q: What is included in a Full Service?
A: The Full Service (Standard, SGD 160) includes full movement disassembly, ultrasonic cleaning, lubrication, regulation to +/-5 s/day, water resistance test, case light polish, and new gaskets. The Premium tier (SGD 220) adds deep case polish, crystal replacement if scratched, and a 12-month service warranty.

metadata.question: What is included in a Full Service?

id: faq::general::My watch is losing time. What service do I need?
text:
Q: My watch is losing time. What service do I need?
A: If your watch is losing or gaining more than 15 seconds per day, a Regulation Service (SGD 85) is recommended. This includes movement cleaning and regulation to +/-5 s/day with a timing machine report.

metadata.question: My watch is losing time. What service do I need?

id: faq::general::How often should I service my watch?
text:
Q: How often should I service my watch?
A: We recommend a Full Service every 3-5 years for automatic movements, or when you notice significant timekeeping deviation.

metadata.question: How often should I service my watch?

id: faq::general::How do I send my watch in for servicing?
text:
Q: How do I send my watch in for servicing?
A: Pack your watch securely and ship it to our Singapore service centre (address provided at checkout). We recommend insured shipping. For international customers, a SGD 25 surcharge covers insured return shipping.

metadata.question: How do I send my watch in for servicing?

id: faq::general::Is there a warranty on servicing?
text:
Q: Is there a warranty on servicing?
A: The Premium Full Service includes a 12-month service warranty. A 12-month warranty extension can be added to any service for SGD 30.

metadata.question: Is there a warranty on servicing?

text:
Q: How long does shipping take?
A: Standard shipping within Singapore: 3-5 business days. International: 7-14 business days depending on destination. Express shipping is available at checkout.

metadata.question: How long does shipping take?

text:
Q: Do you ship internationally?
A: Yes, we ship worldwide. Customers are responsible for any applicable customs duties and import taxes in their country.

metadata.question: Do you ship internationally?

text:
Q: What is your return policy?
A: We accept returns within 14 days of delivery for unworn, unmodified items in original packaging. Engraved items are non-returnable unless there is a manufacturing defect.

metadata.question: What is your return policy?

id: faq::general::My order hasn't arrived. What should I do?
text:
Q: My order hasn't arrived. What should I do?
A: Please check your tracking number first. If tracking shows no update for more than 5 business days, contact us at support@boldr.co with your order number and we will investigate.

metadata.question: My order hasn't arrived. What should I do?

id: faq::general::What is the warranty on Boldr watches?
text:
Q: What is the warranty on Boldr watches?
A: All Boldr watches come with a 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering movement defects. The warranty does not cover physical damage, water damage beyond the rated depth, or normal wear and tear.

metadata.question: What is the warranty on Boldr watches?

text:
Q: Do you offer gift wrapping?
A: Yes. Select the gift wrapping option at checkout (SGD 8). The watch will be presented in a premium gift box with a ribbon and a personalised gift card.

metadata.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?

id: faq::general::What is the difference between the Expedition and Journey?
text:
Q: What is the difference between the Expedition and Journey?
A: The Expedition (40mm, Grade 5 Ti) is larger, heavier-duty, and rated to 100m water resistance - suited for active use. The Journey (38mm, Grade 2 Ti) is slimmer, lighter, and more dress-casual - rated to 50m. Both use automatic movements.

metadata.question: What is the difference between the Expedition and Journey?

text:
Q: Do you offer bulk/corporate pricing?
A: Yes. For orders of 10 or more watches, please contact us at corporate@boldr.co for a custom quote.

metadata.question: Do you offer bulk/corporate pricing?

[SOP - Overview]
This document describes how our customer service team handles inbound enquiries today. We receive enquiries primarily by email through our Gmail inbox. All replies are sent manually by a CS team member after checking the relevant reference documents.

[SOP - Reference Documents]
- FAQ Document - Common questions on returns, shipping, warranty, materials, care
- Engraving Rate Card - Pricing, character limits, turnaround, script types
- Servicing Rate Card - Battery, regulation, full service pricing and turnaround
- Product One-Pager - Model specs, materials, strap options, compatibility
- Shopify Admin - Order status, tracking, fulfilment, refund status

[SOP - Tone & Brand Voice]
- Friendly but not overly casual - we are a premium brand
- Direct - answer the question clearly, do not pad with filler
- Helpful - if we cannot help directly, point them somewhere useful
- Never promise what you are not sure about - check first

Good example reply opening: "Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out! Happy to help with that."

Avoid:
- Starting every reply with "Great question!"
- Using overly formal language ("Dear Sir/Madam")
- Making promises about timelines you cannot guarantee

[SOP - Escalation Triggers]
Escalate to the team lead whenever:
- A customer is angry or threatening a chargeback
- A warranty claim involves significant damage or potential product defect
- A refund has been outstanding for more than 10 business days
- A corporate or bulk order enquiry comes in (more than 5 units)
- You are not sure of the answer and cannot find it in the reference documents
- A media or press enquiry comes in - forward to marketing@boldr.co

[SOP - Order Handling Rules]
- Always check Shopify first before replying. Do not guess order status.
- Tracking not updating after 5+ business days: escalate to shipping carrier
- Wrong item received: ask for a photo, flag to team immediately
- Change delivery address: only possible if not yet dispatched
- Cancel order: if unfulfilled, cancel and refund. If shipped, ask customer to return it
- Customs duties: customer is responsible

[SOP - Engraving Rules]
- Within 1 hour of order: amend for free
- 1-24 hours after order: SGD 15 amendment fee
- After production has started: not possible
- Logo/custom artwork: requires vector file, team approval
- Engraved items are non-returnable unless manufacturing defect

[SOP - New Questions Log]
If a customer asks something not in any reference document:
1. Reply honestly: "Let me check on that and get back to you."
2. Add to New Questions Log
3. Discuss at weekly CS check-in
4. Once answered, update the FAQ document

[SOP - Contacts]
- CS Team Lead: cs@boldr.co
- Service Centre: service@boldr.co
- Corporate Sales: corporate@boldr.co
- Marketing: marketing@boldr.co
